title: What the Koala means

is_this_you.pressure: You go still and let the storm spend itself somewhere else. Pushed past that, the soft one bites, and nobody forgets it.
is_this_you.love: You choose by taste, then stay in that one tree long after others would have wandered.
is_this_you.cost: Some years you wait by the stump for the good thing to come back the way it came before.

opener.text: You were born under two signs that both look toward the Moon. Taurus is ruled by Venus, and the Moon is exalted there [s1]. The Rabbit of the Chinese zodiac lives on the Moon as the Jade Rabbit, keeping Chang'e company and pounding the elixir of long life [s6]. So you came in by soft light, and you have always done your best living slowly.

howto: Three short parts. Tap one, or read them in order.

tabs.label: How you're built
tabs.intro: Earth that settles, Wood that keeps watch.

rows.text: Taurus is fixed Earth, the sign that settles on the one good thing and stays [s1]. The Rabbit is yin Wood, gentle and alert, the animal that keeps watching while it rests [s3] [s4]. In you the two become a settled watcher. You can sit in one place all afternoon and still know which way you would leave.

The koala lives the same way. Even among trees of one species, it feeds less on leaves heavy with a toxic compound called sideroxylonal, and it passes over the poorest trees [s14] [s15]. It chooses by taste. So do you, and once a tree has fed you, a whole forest of better offers has trouble moving you.

tabs.label: Who you choose
tabs.intro: Three trees that will feed you, and one that won't.
tabs.love_lead: In love you open late and close slowly. You need someone who reads your stillness as care. The old Chinese pairings give you three easy matches.

tabs.label: Where you work
tabs.intro: Your taste is the skill. Find work that pays for it.

rows.text: At work, give yourself one deep thing and no hurry. Tasting, curating and editing all reward a difference only you can taste.

easy.why: The Clark's Nutcracker (Virgo, Goat year) shares your trine of Rabbit, Goat and Pig, and Virgo is Earth like you [s3].
The Tibetan Blue Bear (Capricorn, Dog year) is your secret friend, since the Dog is the Rabbit's hidden ally, and Capricorn is the third Earth sign [s3].
The Capybara (Cancer, Pig year) is trine kin, with Cancer's Water to soften your Earth [s3] [s1].

hard.why: The hard one is the Devil's Flower Mantis: the Rooster clashes with the Rabbit, and Scorpio sits opposite Taurus [s3] [s1].

story.text: The Gumbaynggirr tell of the Koala Brothers, who made a bridge home out of their own long insides [s8].

closing: You have always carried the way back inside you.
